newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer says to extend Highlands offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer says to extend Highlands offer.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Friday it would extend its A$0.75 a share takeover offer for Highlands Gold Ltd for one week to January 25 and that it currently held over 58 percent of Highlands shares.
Placer Dome said it had been approached by a number of shareholders seeking the extension. However, it said the offer was final and would not be extended beyond January 25.
The Highlands board earlier on Friday repeated its recommendation that its shareholders reject the offer.
Highlands said earlier it had an offer from Papua New Guinea institutions to invest and underwrite a share issue to raise A$110 million, which would allow a restructuring of the company.

Highlands said the offer envisaged Placer Dome buying Highland's 25 percent interest in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea and Highlands shareholders other than Placer receiving 65 cents, plus one share in a new company holding Highland's other assets.
These assets include the Ramu nickel/cobalt and Frieda Nena copper/gold projects in PNG and an exploration portfolio in PNG and Indonesia.
Placer's announcement to the Australian Stock Exchange on the extension of its offer made no mention of the underwriting announcement.
